hypotheses.title: Call Option Volatility Premium and Capex Discipline
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Six-month call option implied volatility (implied_volatility_call_180) relative to 60-day realized Parkinson volatility (parkinson_volatility_60) isolates equities where upside speculative option demand exceeds actual price volatility. Stabilizing with announced capital expenditure intensity (anl4_capex_value / assets) captures an orthogonal volatility risk premium with near-zero correlation to accounting earnings.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha returns fail during systemic market volatility spikes.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_backfill(implied_volatility_call_180 / parkinson_volatility_60, 60), sector) - 0.5, 2) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_mean(ts_backfill(anl4_capex_value, 252), 252) / (ts_backfill(assets, 60) + 1000), sector) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, sector)

hypotheses.title: Operating Cash Flow Yield in Broad Market Neutrality
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Operating Cash Flow from analyst estimates (anl4_cfo_value) ranked across the broader market rather than restricted to sectors unleashes full optimizer capital allocation, repeating the market-neutral architecture of Alpha 1 that delivered self-correlation of 0.5768.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails to outperform during broad market liquidity shocks.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(anl4_cfo_value, 60) / close, 180), market) - 0.5, 2) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_mean(ts_backfill(anl4_capex_value, 252), 252) / (ts_backfill(assets, 60) + 1000), market) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, market)

hypotheses.title: Balance Sheet Cash Solvency Yield and Capex Discipline
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Cash and short-term liquid investments (cash_st) scaled by close measures pure solvency yield. Pairing cash reserves with ongoing capital expenditure reinvestment intensity isolates self-funding, high-liquidity compounders that resist refinancing crunches.
confounders: Unproductive cash hoarding by mature firms
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms during speculative junk-bond rallies.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(cash_st, 60) / close, 180), sector) - 0.5, 2) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_mean(ts_backfill(anl4_capex_value, 252), 252) / (ts_backfill(assets, 60) + 1000), sector) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, sector)
